alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation is smaller than productcatalogservice's (z=455 vs z=944, E1). Its slowdown matches waiting on productcatalogservice, whose caller-observed latency jumped 2.42->202.98ms (E2).

Its own processing time stayed flat (p50 0.01->0.02ms) while caller-observed latency rose 83.7x (E2). CPU saturation would raise its own processing time, so this pattern points to network delay instead.
